children.value: > Fact From Story: From what I see, Smith is running shorter routes and is getting open faster than Pitts.
> > Fact From Story: That's earned him some targets from Ridder, who seemed to have better timing with Smith than Pitts.
> > > Fact From Story: Smith is not drawing any kind of tight coverage like Pitts either, mostly because he's staying closer to the line of scrimmage.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Quarterbacks are more likely to throw to receivers who are not tightly covered.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A receiver who is open more often is more likely to be targeted.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Quarterbacks tend to throw to receivers who are open.
